title: RenderDock Beta — November Usage Report
subtitle: Prepared for beta users and stakeholders
author: RenderDock Team

sections.title: What shipped
paragraphs: The rendering queue went live in week two and has been stable since. This month we focused on the agent-native delivery paths: the MCP server shipped to the official registry, and the n8n community node passed its first build.
bullets: MCP server published — agents get a render tool that returns file paths
n8n node published — invoices, reports, and screenshots on a schedule
Paddle billing connected — paid tiers ready for the first paying customer

sections.title: What's next
paragraphs: Template packs for invoices and certificates are live on renderdock.dev/templates — pull one, fill in your data, render. We are also watching the waitlist closely: the first cohort of beta users gets invited this week, and their feedback will set the roadmap for December.
